scope: Research, source-code and existing results review, filesystem metadata, Google Drive visible file information. No training, model installation or bulk download.
project_status: Implementation and training paused at user request; strategy and storage audit only

google_drive_cache.limits: Metadata sum is not allocated-disk-space measurement or the upload queue size; historical disk-exhaustion events and all per-account settings were not examined.

google_drive_web_file_details.previous_version_observation: Earlier task inspected this file and saw only its current version

cloud_file_limits: Displayed rounded sizes only, not exact-byte metadata or a separately downloaded cloud SHA. These two web files are also much smaller than the first file's declared mdat length; this does not establish the original failure stage or all other cloud files' state.

existing_v4_cache_metadata.measurement: Manifest fields and file stat only; no frame payloads loaded and no new inference
existing_v4_cache_metadata.duration_definition: duration_seconds is the sum of labeled end_time minus start_time. Cache frame playback duration is frames / 25 (train 4496.8s, val 85.76s, test 242.4s), slightly different due to resampling.

official_olkavs_weights_visible.limits: File presence and display size do not verify checkpoint format, integrity, licensing or local runtime compatibility.
